findings.title: Exercise guarded absolute JS publication through its production caller in the regression test
findings.problem: The xorxl.11 regression directly supplies Some(base) to write_approved_file_cancellable. It would still pass if production write_guarded_path again forgot to forward the checked digest, which was the original defect.
evidence: The new test computes base itself and calls the lower-level helper with Some(base) at10279-10283.
Production forwarding is a separate call at2218. No inspected test invokes that call while mutating the target between guard authorization and publication.
Existing a_file_changed_after_the_read_is_refused mutates a relative-path file before invoking the JS tool; it protects stale read authorization, not the later absolute-path publication boundary.
findings.fix: Add one deterministic behavioral test through write_guarded_path or the parent effect service, using an absolute path and a controlled mutation after overwrite authorization but before atomic publication. Reuse the existing helper test as lower-level coverage.
acceptance_tests: After a complete read, the guarded production absolute-path call encounters a same-length intervening change, returns TargetChanged and preserves those newer bytes.
The corresponding unchanged absolute-path overwrite succeeds.
Negative control: temporarily dropping only the production forwarded digest makes the new regression fail while the lower-level helper test still passes.
Use a bounded test-only seam; no sleep-dependent race or production behavior change.
findings.current_production_status: Source fix is correct; this is missing protection against recurrence.

findings.title: Report unreadable listing entries and subtrees instead of presenting complete or empty results
findings.problem: list_dir silently drops a directory when its child descriptor cannot be opened, converts child-count read failure to0, and ignores recursive collect_level errors without setting incomplete. A readable parent containing unreadable children can therefore be shown as empty or complete with no omission notice.
evidence: BoundDirectory::list_entries continues on open_child failure at928-929 and uses unwrap_or(0) for a child read_directory failure at940-942.
collect_level discards recursive errors at99-106 without changing its incomplete flag.
The result path emits (empty directory) for an empty rows vector at294-295, while its incomplete notices are currently reserved for row caps.
findings.fix: Keep a bounded record of unreadable entry/subtree omissions and unknown child counts, and disclose incomplete coverage in list_dir results; do not disclose paths hidden by permission-deny filters or ignored-directory policy.
acceptance_tests: Under a non-root Unix test account, a readable parent with one chmod000 child does not produce an unqualified empty/complete listing; restore permissions with guaranteed cleanup.
A subtree that becomes unreadable during depth2/3 collection is reported as incomplete; a failed count is shown as unknown rather than exact zero.
Permission-denied policy paths remain hidden and ordinary count/offset paging stays unchanged.

findings.title: Update the obsolete seven-operation Git description
findings.problem: The permission documentation says the structured Git tool accepts only seven fixed local operations. Its current enum has16 local operations, including blame, branch creation/switching, stash, tag and restore. Operators following the paragraph get an incomplete account of available mutations and permission keys.
evidence: CONFIG.md2560 states the obsolete seven-operation contract.

GitOperation currently defines16 operations, including BranchCreate, Switch, StashPush, StashPop, Tag and Restore. The no-network/remotes statement in the following sentence remains accurate and should be retained.
findings.fix: Replace the stale operation count/list with the current operation and authorization model or link to its maintained owning section. Preserve accurate local-only, literal pathspec, filter-driver and commit behavior statements.
acceptance_tests: Review the paragraph against GitOperation and the actual parameters/permission keys, including the newer local mutations.
Search operator docs for the same obsolete seven-operation claim and reconcile exact duplicates; preserve the accurate no-network boundary. No feature change or runtime test is required.
